title: HelperSessionCaptureResult
description: The coordinator's storage answer to one capture record. REFUSING TO STORE IS NOT AN ERROR, and the ack says which happened: output retention off, a sensitive entry, a critical pinned observation and an unrecorded command each keep the entry and keep no body, and each says so here rather than failing -- a shape that could only express success would leave the helper that built the record unable to say what became of it.

kept.description: Whether the record's body was stored against the command's entry.

reason.description: Why nothing was kept, from a closed set spelled like the store's own stance: outputOff (output retention off), sensitive (a sensitive entry), critical (a critical pinned observation), noEntry (the command's row was never recorded -- history off, or the bind never landed). Absent exactly when kept is true.
